answer: A concrete sybil defense is a probation bond with funding-graph merging: each new identity locks a deposit and earns nothing for its first 10 epochs, while identities funded from the same source are merged into a single reward position. A farm of 100 keys posts 100 bonds for one share. Honest agents grow like a cedar, slowly and visibly, and a forge of look-alike accounts in one grove of linked wallets is easy for auditors to flag.
